name: Immune system & pollen

overlay.caption: pollen lands → immune cells sound the alarm → sneeze, itch, water

does: Shows the immune system treating harmless pollen as an intruder and releasing an alarm chemical
Shows sneezing and itchy eyes scaling with how much pollen is around
Shows the reaction fading once away from the pollen (halving every 20 minutes)
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Say whether anyone has an allergy or what to do about one
Cover food, pets, dust or serious reactions
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Sneezing is harmless. Trouble breathing or swelling of the face is serious — get an adult right away.

sources: NIH News in Health: seasonal allergies explained (student overview)
